topic.title: How to Attach a Debugger to

body.p: To attach a debugger to a running Java process, configure the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) to listen for debugging connections. Pass an argument such as the following to the java command: -agentlib:jdwp=transport=dt_socket,server=y,suspend=n,address=5005.

To set this argument for the JVM that runs , use the procedure for your distribution. For example:
When using the All Platforms distribution, add this argument on a new line in the oXygenXmlWebAuthor.vmoptions file.
When using the WAR distribution, set the argument for the JVM that runs the servlet container. With Tomcat, set the CATALINA_OPTS environment variable to include the argument.
To connect a debugger, you need to follow the instructions provided by your IDE and use port 5005 (as configured above).
body.note: If you are using Eclipse, you can start the WAR distribution of in debug mode directly from the IDE.
